title: COA: ‘Deficiencies’ affect implementation of P531-B DPWH projects
summary: “Deficiencies” have contributed to the “inefficient” implementation of Department of Public Works and Highways (DPWH) projects worth P531.7 billion, the Commission on Audit (COA) has found.
